description: At the Palace of Knossos, the frame shows the reconstructed Grand Staircase: stone steps and Minoan columns painted deep red, wider at the top than the base. Lower ruined walls sit beside the reconstruction rather than a complete ancient palace. Cloud cover is about 61%, about 18.8°C. The site is closed and unlit, so the stone is in moonlight.
